* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kelnacca (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 26 December 2025: “Once per turn, if Wookiee Homestead on table, may place a card from hand on Force Pile to draw bottom card of your Force Pile. Once per game, may deploy a unique (•) forest from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to Wookiee Strangle and You Are Beaten.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Kelnacca]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Kelnacca]] (published 2 December 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Kelnacca”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image of 27 December 2025<ref name="ht-ke-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/21bad40/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Light/large/kelnacca.gif kelnacca.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/21bad40 21bad40] (27 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark.
